MINING RISE = iron-milestone occupancy: 57 of 71 canary mine decisions post were in gather_iron_ore_3 (four bots); mines per iron-milestone decision 0.57 post vs 0.56 in the 3 h before (control 0.47 vs 0.51); non-iron mining fell. E:167 vs E:178 reconciled: 167 counts deaths in the 3 h before (control 9, canary 1; live files only, missing 23:46:55-24:00 which held no deaths), 178 is per bot over the 30 min before (control 1/65 = 0.02). THE CHANGE (Codex APPROVE r3 on 47110e8): chestWalk -- the walk to a chest and to a new chest's cell runs withTimeout with needsDrop:false (no watchDigging) and clears the goal on timeout only if it is still the walk's own; A RESOLVED WALK IS NOT AN ARRIVAL (eyes > 5.5 from the chest after goto resolved = no path; mineflayer-pathfinder resolves an empty noPath); ONE town boundary inTown (16 horizontal AND 12 vertical) for memory read/write, walk start, nearHome, sweep and site; DEEP containers (|dy| > 12) are never deposit targets and not 'storage' to admission, the prompt's CARRYING line or deposit_surplus.done(); closesBank -- only refuse_cap/no_site/craft_failed/place_failed/retry_failed (a new chest that OPENED and took nothing) close the bank, a defer closes nothing and backs the container off in the town memory; an interrupted walk strikes/backs off nothing and ends the attempt; a failed walk to a chest OUTSIDE town backs it off for that bot 10 min (never a town chest); a sweep walk from outside town strikes no town chest; craft's room advice names a deposit only where admission would take it, else 'home -- then deposit X'. Banking reminders and the return milestone are unchanged unless the bank is truly closed. TESTS: 225/225 files (node scripts/run-tests.mjs) on 47110e8; chest-full.test.mjs 60/60 (18 new C2 behaviour tests); 23/23 mutants killed by the named test, every anchor asserted present and unique; eslint clean on the five changed src files (the only error tree-wide is the pre-existing guarded withinBody in reflex.mjs). PAPER (sandbox/craft/chest-ab.cjs, 10-05 06:41-08:00Z, server oracle): deep -- control 6c9a8fb 1/1 banked 96 into the chest 20 below home, candidate 3/3 (1 on 741d897, 2 on 47110e8) left it untouched (walked for the town chest; failed no_path from the sealed pit); one-cell pocket mid-walk (no legal move) -- control 2/2 'arrived' 17-18 short, the open timed out, it struck the good town chest and CLOSED THE BANK; candidate 2/2 no_path in 2.2 s, no strike, no closure; a 7-cell sealed tunnel -- both arms 4/4 no_path, nothing struck; watchDigging fired in 0 trials of either arm (no concurrent dig occurred inside a deposit window); carried 1/1 placed the carried chest 5.7 from home, craft 1/1 crafted+placed, budget 1/1 refuse_cap + the bank_closed chain, roomy 1/1, site 1/1 (3.0 from home, 7.2 from the composter), far 1/1 decision=far; nothing dropped and everything conserved in every trial (those six on 741d897; the round-2 delta touches neither path). exposure.note: Ready = >= 20 canary-build deposit rows (the new deposit code ran: bounded first walk, town memory, the recovery on an unusable first chest) AND >= 1 control deposit whose first chest was unusable (full / open failed / lid / used another; 43-44 in the 6 h dry run 10-05). own_lines.note: C1: a placement (placed=1) with home_d > 16 or composter_d < 3 -- chestSiteRefusal forbids both.

C2: the town CLAIM LEDGER the bots write (/var/lib/mcai/_pool-<pool>/town-chest-*.c<n>.json + observations): two claims < 10 min apart, > 4 in any rolling 24 h, or > 12 standing, where a claim made after the cutoff is involved. Read from the file the budget itself reads, not from row times (rows stamp the end of the retry deposit).

C3: more than one unsettled-transfer EVENT (a failed _deposit_cursor_rescue and the transfer_unsettled deposit it ends are one event: the deposit row is stamped at its START and the rescue inside its span).
C4 (the root cause): a decision=craft row whose END snapshot holds more chests/trapped chests than the decision explains (1 when a crafted chest was not placed, else 0).
Arms: control _deposit_new_chest + _deposit_cursor_rescue rows + control pools with a claim after the cutoff. BLOCKS KEEP.
